name: Gammerita, Mon!
summary: At Revantusk Village, Katoom the Angler wants his best lure back from Gammerita, Mon!, who leads the saltwater snapjaws. Find her and recover it.

sections.title: A Thief Among the Turtles
sections.body: Katoom says Gammerita, Mon! is no ordinary turtle. She leads the saltwater snapjaws, and he calls her a thief. She snapped his best lure off his line. Since then, the fish have not bitten as they once did.

sections.title: Getting the Lure Back
sections.body: Katoom wants you to find Gammerita, Mon! and recover his lure from her stomach. She stays along the coast among the other turtles.

sections.title: Katoom's Hopes
sections.body: With his lure back and fewer snapjaws about, Katoom expects the fish to come in by the heap.

faq.answer: Katoom the Angler fishes at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands. He asks you to hunt Gammerita, Mon!.
Gammerita, Mon! is no ordinary turtle. She leads the saltwater snapjaws, and Katoom calls her a thief.

faq.q: Why does Katoom want Gammerita dead?
faq.answer: Gammerita, Mon! snapped Katoom's best lure off his line, and the fish have not bitten as they once did. He wants it back from her stomach.
Gammerita, Mon! stays on the coast among the other saltwater snapjaw turtles.
